item.title: [翻译] Construction Physics: 5月2日阅读清单
item.description:
标签: #建筑住房 #基础设施 #工业技术 #供应链

摘要: 这是一篇关于建筑、基础设施与工业技术的每周阅读汇总，核心内容涵盖伊朗战争引发的全球供应链冲击（如PCB和能源）、美国住房立法对“建后出租”市场的寒蝉效应，以及机器人制造规模化、数据中心扩张与国防工业等多个制造业热点议题。

原标题: Reading List 05/02/2026

Reading List 05/02/2026

阅读清单 2026年5月2日

Welcome to the reading list, a weekly roundup of news and links related to buildings, infrastructure, and industrial technology. This week we look at chilling effects in the build-to-rent sector, how fast could robot manufacturing scale up, PJM’s new interconnection queue, the backlash against battery storage, and more. Roughly 2/3rds of the reading list is paywalled, so for full access become a paid subscriber.

欢迎来到本期阅读清单，这是与建筑、基础设施和工业技术相关的每周新闻与链接汇总。本周我们将探讨建房出租（build-to-rent）领域的寒蝉效应、机器人制造能以多快速度扩大规模、PJM的新并网队列（interconnection queue）、对电池储能（battery storage）的反对声浪，以及更多话题。阅读清单中约有三分之二的内容设有付费墙，如需完整访问，请成为付费订阅者。

War in Iran

伊朗战争

The latest war-related supply chain disruption? Printed circuit boards. “Iran struck Saudi Arabia’s Jubail petrochemical complex in early April, ​forcing a halt in production of high-purity polyphenylene ether (PPE) resin — a critical base material used to ⁠manufacture PCB laminates…In April alone, PCB prices surged as much as 40% from March, Goldman Sachs ​analysts said in a recent note.” [Reuters]

最新与战争相关的供应链中断是什么？印刷电路板（Printed Circuit Boards, PCB）。“伊朗于四月初袭击了沙特阿拉伯的朱拜勒石化综合体，迫使高纯度聚苯醚（Polyphenylene Ether, PPE）树脂停产——这是用于制造PCB层压板（PCB laminates）的关键基础材料……仅在四月，PCB价格较三月飙升多达40%，高盛（Goldman Sachs）分析师在最近一份报告中表示。”[路透社]

Thanks to high jet fuel prices, India’s airlines are apparently “on the verge of closing down.” [SCMP] And the biggest US airlines collectively spent $1.2 billion more on jet fuel in the first quarter of 2026 compared to 2025. [Sherwood]

由于航空燃油（jet fuel）价格高企，印度航空公司据称“正处于倒闭边缘”。[SCMP] 而美国最大的几家航空公司在2026年第一季度的航空燃油支出合计比2025年同期多出12亿美元。[Sherwood]

Shipping isn’t the only sort of Strait of Hormuz traffic that the war has the potential to disrupt. The strait also carries a large number of undersea cables that could possibly be damaged if damaged ships drag their anchors across them. ““In a situation of active military operations, the risk of unintentional damage increases, and the longer this conflict lasts, the higher the likelihood of unintentional damage,” Kotkin said. A similar incident occurred in 2024, when a commercial vessel attacked by Iran-aligned Houthis drifted in the Red Sea and severed cables with its anchor.” [Reuters]

航运并非这场战争可能干扰的唯一霍尔木兹海峡（Strait of Hormuz）交通类型。该海峡还承载大量海底电缆（undersea cables），如果受损船只拖曳锚链从其上方经过，这些电缆可能会遭到破坏。““在积极军事行动的情况下，意外损坏的风险会增加，而且冲突持续的时间越长，意外损坏的可能性就越高，”Kotkin表示。2024年曾发生过类似事件，当时一艘遭到伊朗支持的胡塞武装袭击的商船在红海漂流，并用其锚链切断了电缆。”[路透社]

Housing

住房

One problem with ill-considered legislation is that negative consequences can sometimes be caused by the mere possibility that it passes. So if you have a housing bill with a provision that wouldmake it much more difficult to build homes for rent(by requiring institutional owners to divest those homes after seven years), even the mere threat of it passing is enough to slow down rental housing construction. “Developer TerraLane Communities was about to start construction on two new housing communities in Arizona and Texas, projects that would create around 300 new single-family homes to rent out. But before any shovels got in the ground, the Senate passed a bill that severely restricts the build-to-rent business. Uncertain about the industry’s legislative future, investors demanded that TerraLane pause the project. The firm had five other potential build-to-rent deals that it is no longer pursuing.” [WSJ]

考虑不周的立法所带来的一个问题是，负面后果有时仅仅源于其可能通过的不确定性。因此，如果一项住房法案包含一项条款，将使建造出租房屋变得困难得多（要求机构所有者在七年后剥离这些房屋），那么即使只是该法案可能通过的威胁，也足以减缓租赁住房的建设。“开发商TerraLane Communities即将在亚利桑那州和德克萨斯州开始建设两个新住宅社区，这些项目将建造约300套新的独户住宅用于出租。但在破土动工之前，参议院通过了一项严重限制建房出租（build-to-rent）业务的法案。由于对该行业的立法前景感到不确定，投资者要求TerraLane暂停项目。该公司另有五项潜在的建房出租交易，也不再继续推进。”[WSJ]

When is the best time to buy and sell a home? The graphic below tracks the conventional wisdom – better to buy in the summer when there’s more listings, and sell in the winter when there’s fewer — but it’s interesting to see the data. [Substack]

什么时候是买卖房屋的最佳时机？下图追踪了传统观点——最好在夏季购买，因为房源更多；在冬季出售，因为房源更少——但看看数据会很有趣。[Substack]

We previously looked at UK building standards which, if complied with, effectively require houses to have extremely small windows so they can be cleaned by an elderly woman without stretching. The Wall Street Journal takes a closer look at this requirement. [WSJ]

我们此前曾关注过英国建筑标准（UK building standards），如果严格执行，这些标准实际上要求房屋安装极小的窗户，以便老年女性无需伸展身体就能清洁窗户。《华尔街日报（The Wall Street Journal）》对这一要求进行了更深入的探讨。[WSJ]

Americans who are importing their homebuilding materials from China. [CNN]

从中国进口住宅建筑材料（homebuilding materials）的美国人。[CNN]

So far this year Idaho has passed six bills to make it easier to build housing. [Sightline]

今年到目前为止，爱达荷州（Idaho）已通过了六项法案，以简化住房建设流程。[Sightline]

Manufacturing

制造业

The data center buildout continues to put pressure on every related area of the supply chain for them. To meet the rising demand for AI chips, ASML is ramping up production of EUV machines. [WSJ]

数据中心（Data center）建设持续对其供应链的每一个相关环节施加压力。为满足对AI芯片不断增长的需求，ASML正在加大EUV光刻机（EUV machines）的生产。[WSJ]

China is no longer the sole producer of a critical mineral, samarium, used to make military-grade magnets. [WSJ]

中国不再是用于制造军用级磁体的关键矿物钐（samarium）的唯一生产国。[WSJ]

AI-analysis nonprofit Epoch AI asks how quickly robot manufacturing could scale up. “Historical demand shocks such as WWII mobilization, or the production of drones following the war in Ukraine have accelerated production growth rates by 1.4–2.2x in the most comparable cases. This would imply doubling times of roughly 5–8 months for quadrupeds and 10–16 months for mature form factors. It’s unclear whether these cases are optimistic or pessimistic for robotics.” [Epoch]

人工智能分析非营利组织Epoch AI探讨了机器人制造能以多快速度扩大规模。“在最可比的情况下，历史性的需求冲击——如二战动员，或乌克兰战争后的无人机生产——已将生产增长率加快了1.4至2.2倍。这意味着四足机器人（quadrupeds）的产量翻倍时间约为5至8个月，而成熟形态机器人（mature form factors）则为10至16个月。目前尚不清楚这些案例对机器人行业而言是乐观还是悲观的。”[Epoch]

The US’s recent…unreliability with regards to its foreign allies has apparently inspired European countries to take defense production more seriously. Germany has ramped up ammunition manufacturing, and is now producing more ammunition than the US. [Newsweek]

美国近期在对待外国盟友方面的……不可靠性显然激励了欧洲国家更认真地对待国防生产。德国（Germany）已加快弹药制造步伐，目前的弹药产量甚至超过了美国。[Newsweek]

On the other hand, the US is apparently seriously considering using foreign shipyards for naval ship design and component manufacturing. [USNI News]

另一方面，美国据称正认真考虑利用外国造船厂进行海军舰艇设计和零部件制造（component manufacturing）。[USNI News]

摘要: 作者通过手机上的 Claude Code 为 mybeats 系统开发了"Sightings"功能，将十余年 iNaturalist 野生动物观测记录回溯导入个人网站，并与其他聚合内容一同展示在主页、归档页及搜索结果中。

原标题: Sightings

Sightings

观察记录

/elsewhere/sightings/

/elsewhere/sightings/

“观察记录”网页截图：页面顶部有搜索栏和 RSS 图标，显示“Filters: Sorted by date”（筛选：按日期排序）及“208 results page 1 / 7 next » last »»”（208 条结果 第 1 / 7 页 下一页 » 末页 »»）。第一条记录：晚上 7:51 的观察记录——橡树啄木鸟（Acorn Woodpecker），配有两张标注为“Acorn Woodpecker”的照片，照片中黑白相间、头顶红冠的啄木鸟栖息在树枝上，日期为 2026 年 5 月 2 日。第二条记录：上午 10:08 至 11:17 的观察记录——橡树啄木鸟、西部栅栏蜥蜴（Western Fence Lizard）、鹗（Osprey），配有三张分别标注为“Acorn Woodpecker”（一只鸟站在光秃树枝上，背景是蓝天）、“Wester...”（树皮上的蜥蜴）和“Osprey”（电线杆上的鸟巢）的照片，日期为 2026 年 5 月 1 日。第三条记录：上午 11:11 的观察记录——白冠带鹀（White-crowned Sparrow），配有一张标注为“White-crowned Sparrow”的照片，画面中一只头部有黑白条纹的麻雀正张嘴鸣唱，日期为 2026 年 4 月 30 日。

“观察记录”网页截图：页面顶部有搜索栏和 RSS 图标，显示“Filters: Sorted by date”（筛选：按日期排序）及“208 results page 1 / 7 next » last »»”（208 条结果 第 1 / 7 页 下一页 » 末页 »»）。第一条记录：晚上 7:51 的观察记录——橡树啄木鸟（Acorn Woodpecker），配有两张标注为“Acorn Woodpecker”的照片，照片中黑白相间、头顶红冠的啄木鸟栖息在树枝上，日期为 2026 年 5 月 2 日。第二条记录：上午 10:08 至 11:17 的观察记录——橡树啄木鸟、西部栅栏蜥蜴（Western Fence Lizard）、鹗（Osprey），配有三张分别标注为“Acorn Woodpecker”（一只鸟站在光秃树枝上，背景是蓝天）、“Wester...”（树皮上的蜥蜴）和“Osprey”（电线杆上的鸟巢）的照片，日期为 2026 年 5 月 1 日。第三条记录：上午 11:11 的观察记录——白冠带鹀（White-crowned Sparrow），配有一张标注为“White-crowned Sparrow”的照片，画面中一只头部有黑白条纹的麻雀正张嘴鸣唱，日期为 2026 年 4 月 30 日。

I built this feature on my phone using Claude Code for web, as an extension of my beats systemfor syndicating external content. Here'sthe PRand prompt.

我在手机上使用 Claude Code（Claude 代码助手）网页版构建了这一功能，作为我的 beats（Beats）系统——用于 syndicating（内容聚合/联合供稿）外部内容——的扩展。这是相关的 PR（Pull Request，拉取请求）和提示词。

As with my other forms of incoming syndicated content sightings show up on the homepage, the date archive pages, and in site search results.

与我的其他 incoming syndicated content（入站聚合内容）一样，观察记录也会出现在 homepage（主页）、日期归档页面以及 site search（站内搜索）结果中。

I back-populated over a decade of iNaturalist sightings, which means you that if you search for lemur you'll see my lemur photos from Madagascar in 2019!

我为 iNaturalist（iNaturalist 自然观察平台）上的观察记录进行了 back-populated（回填），补录了超过十年的数据，这意味着如果你搜索 lemur（狐猴），就能看到我在2019年于马达加斯加拍摄的狐猴照片！
